title: Find Amir
statementMd:
A few years ago Sajjad left his school and register to another one due to security reasons. Now he wishes to find Amir, one of his schoolmates and good friends.

There are $*n*$ schools numerated from $1$ to $*n*$. One can travel between each pair of them, to do so, he needs to buy a ticket. The ticker between schools $*i*$ and $*j*$ costs ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/48a4e5770c4d95918ab20e59965b1361f52acc70.png) and can be used multiple times. Help Sajjad to find the minimum cost he needs to pay for tickets to visit all schools. He can start and finish in any school.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of schools.

## Output

Print single integer: the minimum cost of tickets needed to visit all schools.

## Note

In the first example we can buy a ticket between the schools that costs ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c67d72010e0498bfd065a6a38fdeaec90358507b.png).
statementZhMd:
<statement>
几年前，Sajjad 因为安全原因离开了原来的学校，转入了另一所学校。现在，他希望找到 Amir——他的一位校友和好友。

共有 $*n*$ 所学校，编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。每两所学校之间都可以通行，但需要购买车票。学校 $*i*$ 和 $*j*$ 之间的车票价格为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/48a4e5770c4d95918ab20e59965b1361f52acc70.png)，且可以使用多次。请帮助 Sajjad 求出为了访问所有学校而需要支付的最小车票费用。他可以从任意一所学校出发，也可以在任意一所学校结束行程。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示学校的数量。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数：访问所有学校所需支付的最小车票费用。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，我们可以购买一张连接两所学校的车票，其价格为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c67d72010e0498bfd065a6a38fdeaec90358507b.png)。
</statement>
